rules.closed_day_skip: a date is not tested when its window has fewer than 3 other dates or their median traded count is under 20; closed_day_test_skipped counts windows with such a date
rules.zero_volume: moved when the same line has a traded row in the same window, or when the line has none and its close changes on fewer than no_volume_min_changes days there, day over day in date order (a flat line, or a stale quote that steps once, with no volume is not buyable); a line with no traded row whose close changes on that many days or more keeps every row
rules.nonpositive_price: rows with adjClose NULL or <= 0 moved

sibling.rule: siblings are lines that carry an identical FY key_metrics cap in min_shared_fy FYs or more; a line is tested in a window only when T moved a row before its first remaining row there (the anchor: the earliest moved row), and only against a thicker sibling (median close x volume over the reference days); ref = the median of the per-window median close ratios over the cache's other windows within ref_days (one window each side on an annual leg), with ref_min_windows windows, ref_min_days traded days of both, stable_share of those days within gap of ref, and the anchor's ratio within gap of ref; from the first remaining row, a row more than gap from both ref and the anchor's ratio, for every sibling that can test it, moves; the first row on scale or untestable stops it

rules.twins: SET X-R.BK takes X.BK's ISIN as its security key when X.BK is in the leg, the ISINs share characters 1 to 6 and character 10 of the NVDR's is R; within a key: buyable at entry, then the ordinary line, then isActivelyTrading, home currency, symbol

cap.order: gate on pf or the later consolidations; turnover over every line with the same FY cap (lines that share an identical FY cap in sibling.min_shared_fy FYs or more); k within k_tol of pf lowers first and turnover is tested on the lowered cap; a failing cap is lowered by the divisor (and k) when turnover clears on the lowered cap, else ineligible; a k that disagrees with pf keeps turnover-then-k; unknown turnover lowers; the divisor needs evidence beyond the split records: a measured price factor P (raw close against stock_eod at the period end, or the same line's nearest FY with no split record between) of pf_min or more gives P times the later forward splits, a P under pf_min gives P times the records FMP's FY share count was restated for, no P gives the records at which that count steps; a record repeating the ratio of a record kept within split_dup_days before it counts once; a row is only made ineligible when pf opened the gate and every line of its group has bars in the lookback, else a failing cap lowers; a failing row whose divisor is within 1e-9 of 1 keeps FMP's cap as unchecked, counted in cap_rows_flagged

factor.mode: flag only: no price or return is changed

fill_basis.rule: an LTP fill books its close over the entry close (basis 'close') when the line's adjClose / close flips by more than factor.band's upper bound on consecutive rows while the close moves less than that bound, the flips reverse direction min_reversals times or more from the fetched context to the window end, and the fill's drift against the entry bar leaves factor.band

rules.rule: a line is removed when it is a different instrument from the company's ordinary share (preferred, note, bond, unit, warrant, right, fund) or a second line at its own price on the same financials that no security key collapses, and a book holds what its market's main index can hold: the S&P 500 holds no ADRs, royalty trusts or LPs, the Ibovespa no BDRs; a `keep` line stays whatever a pattern or flag says, and otherwise the first reason in `order` is recorded

order.german_preference: XETRA ticker ending in 3, beside another XETRA line whose ISIN shares its first 9 characters (PNE3.DE, PNE's only line, stays)

order.nasdaq_fifth_letter: five-letter NASDAQ ticker whose fifth letter is P, O, N, M (preferred), W, R, U, Z or V

class_stand_ins.rule: an SAO preferred or unit line of a company with an ordinary line shares that line's security key, so the company holds one slot: the ordinary line when it has an entry price, else the first priced sibling, which stands in; by_period lists the stand-ins each screen picked, as check N's counts do, so a period the cash rule then holds in cash still lists its picks

prior_year_guard.rule: the current FY balance-sheet row has a period end in (T-410, T-45] days, as do the key-metrics and ratios rows; the prior row is the latest 300 to 430 days before it in the same reportedCurrency (NULL matches NULL); a line with none is not ranked: currency_switch when that window holds rows only in another currency, no_prior_in_window when it holds none; counted per line before the security dedup, over the lines in the universe that pass the ROE, ROA, margin and market-cap tests
